title: a responder answers what is theirs and what they are on call for, and nothing else
question: can somebody who is not on call take a page that is not theirs?
rule: mayAnswer asks who is on call, not merely who is logged in — src/auth.js
401 is 'I do not know who you are'; 403 is 'I know, and that is not enough'.

steps.name: an alert on a core service pages nadia, who holds that pager
no token is 401, which is a different sentence from the next one
tomas is a real responder, next in the rotation, and still not the one holding this
a second acknowledgement is a conflict — somebody already has it
and the timeline carries one acknowledgement, not two
an incident nobody opened is 404 rather than 403
